scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-zod run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-client-react run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:libs && npm run build:apps
scripts.runtime:validate: node scripts/runtime_governance_report.cjs && npm run runtime:platform:check && npm run supabase:check
scripts.predeploy:validate: npm run runtime:validate && npm run build:all
scripts.pages:build: BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} PORT=${PORT:-3000} pnpm --filter @workspace/gxeon-dashboard run build && node scripts/github_pages_spa_fallback.cjs
